Market today: The mood is shaky, driven by political shifts and sector-specific weakness in tech. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, is feeling the pinch.

Your holdings: SMCI (-32.54%), MU (-48.29%), and SOXL (-70.33%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs are particularly vulnerable.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the political landscape settles and its impact on tech earnings.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your most significant losses and protecting your capital.
plays: Trim SMCI: Consider reducing exposure given the deep loss and negative momentum.
Trim MU: The leveraged nature and significant loss warrant a review of this position.
Trim SOXL: This leveraged ETF is experiencing severe drawdowns; consider trimming.
